about: Scanner (0.6.8) decisions for a negated command followed by text the scanner does not decode. The Worker answered 'decodes more' for any & % \ or tag character after a look-alike letter and stopped vouching, so these were blocked or flagged at plain severity where the scanner downgrades them. Controls hold a real escape and must keep the cautious answer.
